name: Shrinkify Image Compression
author: shrinkify

sections.description:
Shrinkify makes your website blazing fast by converting your heavy images into next-gen formats like AVIF and WebP.

External services

This plugin uses the Shrinkify API to compress and optimize images.
When optimizing, your image files are securely sent to our cloud API at https://shrinkify.dev/.
The optimized images are returned to your server, and original files are instantly removed from our API servers.
Service provided by Shrinkify.dev.
* Terms of Service: https://shrinkify.dev/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://shrinkify.dev/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/shrinkify-image-compression directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Shrinkify settings and enter your API key.
sections.changelog:
1.2

  • Fix: Excluded SVG and GIF files from auto-optimization to prevent conversion errors.
  • Compatibility: Updated “Tested up to” version to WordPress 7.0.

1.1

  • Performance Boost: Upgraded our core optimization engine for lightning-fast and more reliable image processing.
  • Improved API connectivity for better stability.

1.0

Initial release.
